Education Domain - Online Learning Platforms

Online learning platforms must comply with FERPA, COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act), and accessibility requirements (ADA Section 508).

For E-Learning Platform Registration: Required attributes include student name, student identifier (from institution), date of birth (for age verification and COPPA compliance), email address (required for digital platform), password (encrypted), and institutional affiliation. Parent/guardian consent required for students under 13 per COPPA. Profile photo is optional.

For Virtual Classroom Access: Required attributes include student identifier, course identifier, login credentials, attendance tracking (login time, duration), participation data (chat, polls, questions), and technical requirements verification (device, internet). Audio/video participation may require consent for recording.

For Online Course Enrollment: Required attributes include student identifier, course code, enrollment date, prerequisites verification, fee payment information, and academic standing. Access credentials for course materials. Special accommodations if applicable.

For Digital Assessment: Required attributes include student identifier, assessment identifier, submission timestamps, responses, plagiarism check results, grading, and feedback. Proctoring may require identity verification and monitoring (with consent). Biometric verification (face recognition) requires explicit consent.

For Learning Management System: Required attributes include student identifier, course enrollments, assignment submissions, grades, attendance, and learning analytics (engagement, progress). Course content access logs. Communication records (messages, discussions).

UNNECESSARY Attributes: Religion, ethnicity, political affiliation are unnecessary. Physical address is unnecessary if institutional affiliation is verified. Social media profiles are optional unless integrated into learning activities.

COPPA (15 USC 6501-6506): Platforms targeting children under 13 must obtain verifiable parental consent before collecting personal information.

ADA Section 508: Online learning platforms must be accessible to students with disabilities. Accommodations must be provided.

Data Security: Educational technology platforms must implement appropriate security measures to protect student data. Breaches must be reported per FERPA and state data breach notification laws.
